caseNameFull: Tonya RATHELL, fka Tonya Chakkour v. Ahmed CHAKKOUR.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed until October 28, 2013, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule *37838(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
